redistribution.notes: No repository-level license was verified at the pinned DefenseOps baseline. Atlas may validate the export contract and provenance, but publication/promotion of DefenseOps-derived content must fail closed unless the exported content carries adequate license metadata and G14 review accepts it.

change_detection_policy.notes: Atlas consumes explicit commit-bound validated exports, not arbitrary repository state. DefenseOps origin alone does not establish canonical authority.
